review: Manual semantic audit of actual bodies, source, tools, and issue history

record_bodies_before.courier-relay/protocol-1-receipt-identit: Courier Relay protocol 1 receipt identity and count contract. Applies to the count command (and any later command that dedupes receipts) when protocol "1" is selected. Source: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract) and issue trial-vsf (approved 2026-09-07, owner csells). Rules: (1) A delivery identity is the pair (account_id, delivery_id); the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery. (2) Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: the receipt with the earliest occurred_at UTC instant; equal instants accept the smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order. All other receipts for that identity are duplicates. (3) Accepted receipts keep original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. (4) occurred_at is RFC3339 with seconds, no fractional seconds, Z or explicit numeric offset; compare as UTC instants (offsets may cross a date boundary). Rationale from the provider: delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change it. Protocol selection: omitted "protocol" selects the current protocol (initially "1"); an explicit supported protocol stays supported after a newer current version is introduced. Public suites name a protocol explicitly. count response is exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count"}; empty receipts give 0/0; a single receipt gives 1/0. Implemented in main.py (accepted_receipts_v1, select_protocol); verified with public_tests/count_1.json and manual cross-offset and tie cases on 2026-09-07.
